verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents deploying and running browser agents on its own platform, on a schedule or on demand. It also runs hosted, highly concurrent browser sessions, so developers don't manage browser infrastructure, and it can convert agent runs into reusable Stagehand scripts. However, the evidence frames deployment around agents, not arbitrary developer-written scraping code hosted as serverless functions. missing for 10: explicit documentation of deploying custom developer-authored script code to run on the platform, details of the deployment workflow and runtime limits, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and deploy custom serverless scraping scripts on the platform without managing my own infrastructure

citations.quote: Deploy and run browser agents on Browserbase, on a schedule or on demand.
Use the Optimize tool to turn a completed Agent run into a reusable Stagehand script.
